Cube Storage Pioneers

Little Robots, Big Business

Since its inception in 1996, AutoStore™ has worked to improve warehouse efficiency. Today, the company’s key value proposition is to deliver an easy-to-use software powered cubic automatic storage and retrieval ecosystem.

The AutoStore solution is modular and flexible, and can automate any warehouse. The system offers a superior customer value proposition across operating metrics, ESG scores, and customer economics.
‍

entry.title: 2022 Andover tornado (Wikipedia — did you know?)
entry.content: ... that the 2022 Andover tornado (video featured) injured only three people, despite damaging more than 1,000 buildings?

entry.title: Dithapelo Keorapetse (Wikipedia — did you know?)
entry.content: ... that Dithapelo Keorapetse was named Speaker of the National Assembly of Botswana shortly after losing his bid for election to the legislature?

entry.title: Latin-esque (Wikipedia — did you know?)
entry.content: ... that the 1962 space-age pop album Latin-esque was recorded with halves of the orchestra separated by almost a city block to heighten its stereo effects?

entry.title: Bob Gandey (Wikipedia — did you know?)
entry.content: ... that Bob Gandey founded a circus that continues to be operated by his descendants more than a century later?

entry.title: Lower Chehalis (Wikipedia — did you know?)
entry.content: ... that Hudson's Bay Company ships reserved special rooms for important Lower Chehalis visitors due to their key role in regional trade networks?

entry.title: Mike Hasenfratz (Wikipedia — did you know?)
entry.content: ... that referee Mike Hasenfratz acted in an ice hockey fight in Stay Tuned?

entry.title: Planting a Rainbow (Wikipedia — did you know?)
entry.content: ... that Planting a Rainbow has been praised for both its "deft use of colors" and the educational identification of seeds, bulbs, sprouts, and blossoms?

entry.title: David Bookbinder (Wikipedia — did you know?)
entry.content: ... that David Bookbinder was Margaret Thatcher's "least favourite local government leader"?
